name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: community@example.invalid
description: RuneScape: Dragonwilds is a co-op survival RPG set in the world of RuneScape. Up to 6 players can explore, craft, build, and battle together on a dedicated server. The first-party minimum is 4 GiB RAM; 8 GiB is a conservative six-player allocation.
startup: set -euo pipefail; game_port="{{SERVER_PORT}}"; beacon_port="{{BEACON_PORT}}"; validate_port() { local label="$1" value="$2"; if [[ ! "${value}" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{3,4}$ ]] || ((10#${value} < 1024 || 10#${value} > 65535)); then echo "${label} port is invalid; expected 1024-65535 without leading zeros." >&2; return 1; fi; }; validate_port Game "${game_port}"; validate_port Beacon "${beacon_port}"; if ((10#${game_port} == 10#${beacon_port})); then echo "Game and beacon ports must be different UDP allocations." >&2; exit 1; fi; additional_args="{{ADDITIONAL_ARGS}}"; case "${additional_args,,}" in *-port=*|*-beaconport=*) echo "Additional arguments must not override game or beacon ports." >&2; exit 1;; esac; extra_args=(); if [[ -n "${additional_args}" ]]; then read -r -a extra_args <<< "${additional_args}"; fi; set -f; exec ./RSDragonwildsServer.sh -Port="${game_port}" -BeaconPort="${beacon_port}" -log -ini:Game:[/Script/Engine.GameSession]:MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}} "${extra_args[@]}"

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Quickly checks for any server updates on startup, and updates if necessary. (1 Enable | 0 Disable)

variables.name: [Required] Owner ID
variables.description: Your 32-character RuneScape: Dragonwilds Player ID, shown at the bottom of the in-game Settings menu. The server can boot with a placeholder, but ownership and owner-only controls require your real Player ID.

variables.name: Default World Name
variables.description: The name of the world created on first startup. Players search for your server by this world name in the Public tab of the Worlds screen (case-sensitive). Uploaded worlds will ignore this setting and use their own name instead.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name of your server. Displayed as "Created By" in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Anyone who knows this password can enter Server Management under Pause Menu > Settings and becomes an admin until the password changes. The generated configuration is at RSDragonwilds/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/DedicatedServer.ini.

variables.name: World Password
variables.description: Optional password players must enter to join your server. Will supersede any password stored in the world. Can be left empty if you want anyone to be able to join your world.

variables.name: Administrator List
variables.description: Optional Unreal-style list of 32-character Player IDs that always receive administrator access, for example (ID1,ID2). Leave as () for no pre-authorized administrators.

variables.name: Beacon Port
variables.description: Required second UDP allocation used for the join beacon. It must be different from the primary game allocation. The upstream default is 8888.

variables.name: Additional Launch Arguments
variables.description: Optional advanced arguments passed to the upstream Linux launcher. Shell metacharacters and quoting are rejected; leave blank unless a current Dragonwilds option is required.

variables.name: [System] Dedicated Server App ID
variables.description: Steam App ID used for installation and updates.
